name: What photos or proof do I need before I ask for interior wear-and-tear repair?

mainEntity.name: What photos or proof do I need before I ask for interior wear-and-tear repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photos matter most, along with a clear description of the damage, measurements, and any details about what happened. If the issue involves a rental, lease return, or damage claim, keep dated photos and any repair estimates or invoices together so there is a clean record of what was damaged and how it was handled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Take clear photos, include close-ups and wider shots, and note the size, location, and cause of the damage if you know it.
